spectators.label: Dad with his son on his shoulders
spectators.look: stocky dad with short brown hair and stubble in a light-blue polo shirt and khaki shorts, holding the ankles of a small boy riding on his shoulders; the boy has spiky black hair, a red tee and waves a small plain orange pennant
spectators.idle: dad pointing at the ring, the boy hugging dad's head
spectators.cheer: dad's arms out to the sides yelling, the boy waving the pennant
spectators.shocked: dad's jaw dropped, the boy covering dad's eyes with both hands

spectators.label: Mom with a baby in a front carrier
spectators.look: young mom with shoulder-length wavy auburn hair and a kind face, wearing a mint-green cardigan over a white sundress, with a pink baby carrier strapped to her chest holding a bald baby in a yellow bonnet
spectators.idle: gently swaying, patting the baby's back
spectators.cheer: one fist up cheering, other hand on the baby
spectators.shocked: covering the baby's ears with both hands, eyes wide

spectators.label: Big sister giving a piggyback
spectators.look: teenage girl with two long dark-brown braids and a navy sailor-collar school blouse with a red neckerchief and navy pleated skirt, giving a piggyback to her little brother in green overalls who peeks over her shoulder
spectators.idle: hitching her brother up higher, both watching the ring
spectators.cheer: both cheering, her brother throwing his arms up
spectators.shocked: both mouths open in the same round O

spectators.label: Mom with a toddler on her hip
spectators.look: tired but happy mom with a messy brown bun and round glasses, wearing a purple t-shirt, blue jeans and a canvas tote bag, holding a toddler girl on her hip who has short pigtails, a pink dress and a swirly lollipop
spectators.idle: bouncing the toddler on her hip, the toddler licking the lollipop
spectators.cheer: mom pumping a fist, the toddler waving the lollipop
spectators.shocked: mom's glasses askew, the toddler's lollipop dropping

spectators.label: Hyper kid with a foam hand
spectators.look: excitable little boy with messy chestnut hair and a missing front tooth, wearing a blue-and-white horizontally striped tee and red shorts, one hand inside a giant blue foam pointing-finger glove
spectators.idle: pointing the foam finger at the ring, grinning
spectators.cheer: foam finger thrust straight up, jumping
spectators.shocked: foam finger drooping, mouth wide open

spectators.label: Shy girl hugging a plush dragon
spectators.look: small shy girl with a black bob held by a red hair clip and big round eyes, wearing a bright yellow raincoat and red rain boots, hugging a green plush dragon toy
spectators.idle: peeking at the ring over the plush dragon's head
spectators.cheer: holding the plush dragon up high
spectators.shocked: face hidden in the plush dragon, only her eyes peeking

spectators.label: Kid hero with a towel cape
spectators.look: chubby boy of about nine with a tall cowlick of brown hair and a confident grin, wearing a red bath towel tied as a cape over a green tee, brown shorts and sneakers, holding a cardboard sword
spectators.idle: hero pose with a hand on his hip, sword resting on his shoulder
spectators.cheer: cardboard sword raised high, cape flaring
spectators.shocked: cape flipped over his face, sword bent

spectators.label: Teen fan with a camera
spectators.look: bubbly teenage girl with a high side ponytail dyed teal and star-shaped earrings, wearing an oversized pastel-pink hoodie, denim shorts and chunky white sneakers, holding up a small silver camera
spectators.idle: framing the ring through the camera, tongue out in concentration
spectators.cheer: camera held up high, squealing
spectators.shocked: camera lowered, jaw dropped

spectators.label: Toddler in a bear-ear hoodie
spectators.look: stumpy toddler with chubby cheeks and a blue pacifier, wearing a brown hooded onesie with round bear ears on the hood, holding the string of a red balloon that bobs at head height
spectators.idle: sucking the pacifier, staring at the ring
spectators.cheer: bouncing with both stubby arms up, balloon bobbing
spectators.shocked: pacifier falling out, mouth wide

spectators.label: Mother with a baby on her back
spectators.look: gentle young mother with a neat black bun and a soft smile, wearing a light-brown dress with a white apron, carrying a sleeping baby in a blue cloth sling on her back; the baby wears a red knit hat
spectators.idle: hands folded, glancing back at the sleeping baby
spectators.cheer: waving a white handkerchief, the baby waking up giggling
spectators.shocked: startled with hands raised, the baby crying

spectators.label: Lanky dad with a snack stack
spectators.look: lanky dad with thick glasses, a floppy khaki fishing hat and a goofy smile, wearing an orange shirt with a white palm-tree print, beige shorts and sandals, balancing a tall stack of snack boxes and drinks
spectators.idle: balancing the snack stack, peering around it at the ring
spectators.cheer: snack stack held out to one side, other arm out, cheering
spectators.shocked: snack stack toppling, glasses slipping

spectators.label: Tomboy big sister in a ball cap
spectators.look: sporty girl of about eleven with a short tomboy haircut, a backwards red baseball cap and a bandage on one knee, wearing a red-and-white striped tee and denim shorts, a brown baseball glove on one hand
spectators.idle: punching her fist into the glove, watching
spectators.cheer: glove raised high, shouting
spectators.shocked: cap knocked crooked, mouth open

spectators.label: Little brother in matching stripes
spectators.look: small boy of about six in the same red-and-white striped tee as his big sister, wearing an oversized red baseball cap that slips over his eyes and blue shorts, holding a juice box with a straw
spectators.idle: sipping the juice box, pushing the cap up
spectators.cheer: juice box squeezed overhead, spraying
spectators.shocked: cap fallen over his eyes, juice box squished

spectators.label: Dad with a baby in a dinosaur hat
spectators.look: bearded young dad with a dark man-bun and a relaxed smile, wearing a red-and-black plaid flannel shirt, dark jeans and boots, with a grey front carrier holding a baby in a green dinosaur-spike knit hat
spectators.idle: swaying gently, holding the baby's tiny hand
spectators.cheer: one arm up hollering, the baby flailing happily
spectators.shocked: both hands shielding the baby, eyebrows up

spectators.label: Sporty mom with daughter on her shoulders
spectators.look: athletic mom with a short black pixie cut and a bright yellow windbreaker over black leggings, carrying her daughter on her shoulders; the daughter has orange pigtails, a green dress and spins a rainbow pinwheel
spectators.idle: mom holding the daughter's knees, both watching intently
spectators.cheer: mom's arms out to the sides, the daughter spinning the pinwheel
spectators.shocked: both mouths open, the daughter hugging mom's head

spectators.label: Twin-tail girl with an ice cream
spectators.look: cheerful little girl with bubblegum-pink twin tails tied with yellow star clips, wearing a blue polka-dot dress and white sandals, holding a dripping strawberry ice cream cone
spectators.idle: licking the ice cream cone, eyes on the ring
spectators.cheer: ice cream raised high, giggling
spectators.shocked: ice cream scoop tipping off the cone, mouth open

spectators.label: Rich kid in a sailor suit
spectators.look: prim boy of about ten with a neat blond bob and a snooty smile, wearing a navy sailor suit with a white collar and gold buttons, white knee socks and shiny black shoes, holding small brass opera glasses
spectators.idle: peering through the opera glasses, nose in the air
spectators.cheer: opera glasses waved overhead, cheering despite himself
spectators.shocked: opera glasses dropped, both hands on his cheeks

spectators.label: Teen with big headphones
spectators.look: lanky teenage boy with shaggy dark-blue hair hanging over his eyes and a bored expression, wearing big lime-green headphones around his neck, a grey hoodie, black skinny jeans and red high-top sneakers
spectators.idle: hands in hoodie pockets, pretending not to care
spectators.cheer: headphones flung around his neck, both fists up, finally excited
spectators.shocked: hair blown back revealing wide eyes, hands frozen mid-air

spectators.label: Muscular dad holding a toddler
spectators.look: tanned muscular dad with a black flat-top and a big grin, wearing a white tank top, olive cargo shorts and sandals, holding a toddler in a tiny orange training gi in the crook of one arm
spectators.idle: showing the toddler the ring, pointing
spectators.cheer: lifting the toddler to shoulder height, other arm out to the side
spectators.shocked: pulling the toddler close, mouth open

spectators.label: Schoolgirl with a handmade sign
spectators.look: earnest girl of about twelve with long straight black hair and bangs, wearing a navy school blazer, a green plaid skirt and knee socks, holding up a handmade cardboard sign painted with a red star and a fist (no words)
spectators.idle: holding the sign at chest height, watching hopefully
spectators.cheer: sign lifted high above her head, shouting
spectators.shocked: sign drooping, mouth open, eyes wide
